entries.question: Should a rejected change keep its candidate commit, or should the worktree be discarded?
entries.origin: Principal noticed the retention policy is unstated while designing the attempt model.
entries.why_it_matters: Discarding a rejected candidate destroys the trajectory a postmortem would need; keeping it grows storage without bound.
possible_interpretations: Keep rejected candidates for a bounded retention window.
Keep only the diff and the evidence, not the worktree.
entries.safe_deferral_boundary: Work may proceed until the first long autonomous campaign, which is when storage growth becomes material.

entries.question: Does 'local-first' forbid an optional remote artifact store, or only a mandatory one?
entries.origin: NFR-002 says no mandatory cloud service; docs/ARCHITECTURE.md §14 contemplates remote artifact stores.
entries.why_it_matters: It decides whether the artifact reference format has to carry a remote locator scheme from the start.
entries.resolution: Optional is permitted; NFR-002 forbids only a mandatory service. ArtifactRef carries an opaque locator, so a remote scheme is additive.
